regime_variable: UTC trading-session bucket (Asian [00:00,08:00), European [08:00,16:00), US [16:00,24:00)) at hour t
predictor: within-(hour, session_bucket) cross-sectional rank of abs_fund_pct (high vs low funding)
outcome: next-hour NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED observed liquidation intensity = sum of notional_usd in hour t+1
baseline: within-session-bucket RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, bucket))
inference: block bootstrap across whole UTC hours within each session bucket (seed 20261121, 2000 reps), Holm over 6-test family (3 buckets x {funding contrast, RV persistence}), 2% materiality floor
agreement_with_prior: FCLR-XSEC-006 finds SUPPORTED funding contrasts in ALL THREE UTC session buckets (Asian, European, US) for notional-weighted liquidation intensity, whereas FCLR-XSEC-004/005 found SUPPORTED only in the LOW-RV tercile regime. The session-bucketed regime transform reveals the effect is not confined to low-RV periods but persists across all trading sessions.
